left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  At least 18 years of age

right.raw_text:
-  Enrollment in the UAB CMC-ADHF study under the separate UAB approved research protocol (IRB-300000114, PI Rajapreyar)
  -  Negative urine  [OR] or serum β-hCG test within 48 hours of [11C] acetate administration  [AND] in women  [AND] of child bearing potential

left.raw_text: Women  [AND] who are post-menopausal  [AND] with at least 1 year since last menses  [OR] or documented surgical sterilization will not require pregnancy testing

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Inability to provide informed consent
  -  Pregnancy
  -  Inability to lie still for the imaging study
  -  Weight exceeding the weight limit of the PET imaging table (500 pounds)
